fusions.name: Patient Fang
fusions.desc: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up. Deals 9 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Coiled Strike
fusions.desc: Consumes every affliction on the target and adds 1.4 times their remaining damage to a strike that deals 18 damage. It only strikes a target at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Steady Aim
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 30% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Venom Memory
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, a bolt leaps to the next nearest enemy within 8 tiles, dealing 6 lightning damage and leaving it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
